title: Catio Outdoor Cat Enclosure25-41Outdoor Cat House For Sunbathing, Napping & Overlooking
body_html:
Features:

  • - Window-mounted design expands your cat's territory, providing a personal viewing perch
  • - Installation wings adjust from 25.6" to 41.3", fitting various windows
  • - This catio has a transparent design for observation and enhanced interaction
  • - A clear waterproof acrylic top allows for safe sunbathing and rain protection
  • - Made of fir wood and acrylic, this catio outdoor cat enclosure supports a cat up to 15 lbs.
  • - The modern black and white design easily complements your home's decor
  • - Assembly required

Specification:

  • - Color: Black, White
  • - Material: Fir Wood, Acrylic
  • - Overall Dimensions: 24" L x 18.5" W x 16.1" H
  • - Inner Space: 22.4" W x 16.1" D x 14.6" H
  • - Large Door: 18.9" W x 11.8" H
  • - Maximum Load: 22 lbs.
  • - Item Label: D32-049V00BK

Package Includes:

  • - 1 x Catio
  • - 1 x Top Cover
  • - 1 x Manual
